headline: Electricity pushes inflation to 3.96% in the first half of November
summary: Electricity prices pushed Mexican annual inflation to 3.96% in the first half of November, partly offset by discounts during El Buen Fin; non-food goods fell 0.5%.
why: Inflation data guides Banco de México's interest rate decisions, which affect borrowing costs and the peso.
original_headline: Electricidad presiona inflación a 3.96% en la primera mitad de noviembre
